about_the_game:
Dungeon Destroyer
— A Fresh Take on Roguelike Puzzle Action —

Key Features

  • Auto-Navigation:
    Sit back and watch as your character automatically heads for the stairs while you focus on reconfiguring the dungeon layout to carve out the best route forward.

  • Infinite Retries:
    No need to start over completely—retry as many times as needed within each floor to discover the optimal solution, even if you’re defeated by enemies.

  • Ever-Changing Dungeons:
    Each level is randomly generated, ensuring a fresh challenge and new discoveries every time you play.

  • Casual Yet Strategic:
    Designed for quick sessions that pack a deep puzzle challenge, Dungeon Destroyer combines accessible gameplay with layers of strategic depth.

Take on the Challenge!
Step into Dungeon Destroyer and reshape your destiny in ever-changing dungeons. With its unique blend of automatic progression, infinite retries, and dynamic level design, every adventure promises new surprises and lasting excitement.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3以上、もしくは同等のAMDプロセッサ
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11以上に対応したGPU

short_description: An innovative roguelike puzzle game that changes your fate by reconstructing dungeons. With an auto-navigating hero and floors offering endless retries, each randomly generated dungeon presents fresh challenges. Enjoy a casual yet authentic adventure enriched with deep puzzle elements.
